Dear Cedar Utilities,

Re: R/PM006-1 – Check-Out Works, Flat 21, 11 Juniper Mews, Northbridge, ZZ7 0ZZ

Apologies for any confusion in our earlier emails. The tenant has vacated this property, so please do not try to book the visit with the former tenant. Access for the quote visit will be arranged through Northbridge Lettings.

We need a quote only at this stage, for:
1) Replacing the burnt carpet
2) Repainting throughout

Please do not start any work until we have the landlord's approval.

Could you please reply by end of day tomorrow to confirm whether you can take this job and suggest a date for the quote visit? If you can't take it on, just tell us and we will reassign it.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings Maintenance

This is a check-out job: the agency wants a quote to replace a burnt carpet and repaint throughout after the tenant (Harriet Ellis) moved out. Cedar Utilities was assigned on 20 Sep. They were sent the instruction on 20 Sep and reminders on 21 Sep and 24 Sep (events 005-007). They have not replied, and the system flagged it on 25 Sep (event 008). Every email told them to arrange access with the tenant on 07700 900203. The property is empty, so that was probably the wrong route. Today I emailed Cedar Utilities (outbox msg 4). I told them not to contact the former tenant and that the agency will arrange access. I asked them to confirm by end of tomorrow whether they will take the job and to suggest a date for the quote visit.
